local_binary.notes: Use when MMseqs2 binary is installed on PATH or linked into a local tools directory.

homolog_database.notes: Required for MMseqs2 search. Example: a local UniRef/Swiss-Prot/MMseqs database path with version and checksum.

docker_image.notes: Docker is the preferred fallback when brew/conda/micromamba are unavailable. Pulling an image requires explicit user approval.

trusted_cache.notes: Use only for precomputed trusted MSA/conservation files with source database version and checksum.
